decision.next_responsible_human_decision: Decide whether the corrected negative/control breadth and resource envelope justify exact source-trait and condition selection. Before that decision can support a pilot, add explicit quiet and naturally clipped candidates, isolate dither from bit depth, freeze a perceptual sample-rate conversion condition, and close bounded-drift plus paired leading/trailing-silence plumbing.

non_substitution_rules: A generated low-pass transform does not satisfy the natural_bandwidth_limit source-trait class.
The production hard-clipping recipe does not satisfy the clipped-reference source-trait class.
Generated synthetic fixtures do not satisfy the synthetic-source trait class.
A combined sparse-and-tonal candidate does not establish independent sparse and tonal contrasts.
Dither combined with a 12-bit requantization does not establish an isolated dither contrast.
A deterministic resampler used for alignment or metric views does not establish human truth for a sample-rate-conversion production condition.
Alignment nuisance normalization does not establish perceptual transparency; if a nuisance is treated as an audible intervention it requires a separately counted listening condition.
One condition may count once in the workload even if it carries multiple labels, but its outcomes cannot identify label-specific effects without independent contrasts.
A source trait must be represented by exact grouped members in every partition supporting a corresponding transfer or subgroup claim; pooled capacity cannot substitute.
A transparent lossy condition may overlap an actual codec recipe only after frozen human analysis assigns transparency; nominal codec settings cannot assign it.
